bench_explain:
Metric notes (for readers new to ASR):
- RTF (real-time factor) = processing time / audio duration. RTF 0.03 means a 10s clip takes ~0.3s;
  1.0 is the pass line (keeps up with your speech); lower is faster; above 1.0 you wait after speaking.
- Load(s): how long switching to that model takes.
- Verdict: RTF < 1.0 with valid output = Usable; RTF >= 1.0 = Too slow; no text = No output.
- 'Recommended' = the usable model with the lowest long-clip RTF (most responsive). Switch models: tray right-click > Choose model folder.
bench_no_audio:
No .wav test audio found under asr-modules\.
Put a 16kHz mono wav file into the models folder and retry.
bench_reco_none: No model meets the usable bar (RTF < 1.0 with valid output)
bench_running:
Benchmarking models...

You can close this window; results will pop up automatically when done.
(each model runs a real recognition pass: one short clip + one long clip)
copy_prompt_body:
Please add a new ASR model to local-speak2text (a Windows local offline speech-to-text tray tool built on sherpa-onnx). Requirements:

1. Models live under the app's asr-modules\ subfolder; create one folder per model (name it after the model, e.g. qwen3-asr-1.7B).
2. Required files per model type (use this to check the downloaded package):
   - Qwen3-ASR family: conv_frontend.onnx, encoder.int8.onnx, decoder.int8.onnx, tokenizer\ subfolder (tokenizer config + vocab);
   - SenseVoice-Small: model.int8.onnx, tokens.txt;
   - FireRedASR (AED or CTC): encoder.int8.onnx, decoder.int8.onnx, tokens.txt (CTC has no decoder - not applicable);
   - Paraformer: model.int8.onnx, tokens.txt.
3. Prefer official int8 prebuilt packages from the sherpa-onnx releases page:
   https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/tag/asr-models
   (download <model>-int8-<date>.tar.bz2, extract, copy the files listed above into the new folder.)
4. No config edits are needed - the tool auto-detects the model type from the folder layout; I will pick the folder in the tray menu afterwards.
5. If the model is clearly too heavy for my CPU (official/community RTF well above 0.5), warn me before downloading.
6. When done, verify via the tray menu 'Benchmark models'.

My models folder is: <MODELS_DIR>
